get.description:
The profile grid. Page with ``cursor``, not ``max_id``.

Instagram serves this from the GraphQL profile timeline, which keys paging
on ``profile_grid_items_cursor``. It accepts ``max_id`` and ignores it, so
feeding ``feed.next_max_id`` back returns the first page forever — a silent
loop rather than an error. We reject it instead of reproducing that.
